notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 20 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start - 9': Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Tatooine, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and 'Effect Varies - Squassin'; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Effect Varies - Squassin' dested Squadron Assignments ('Squassin' is the usual nickname); the poster says the starting Effect varies, and Squadron Assignments is the one listed, so it is set as starting.effect.
Section headers ('Other Purple Goober - 1', 'Other Goober - 1', 'FX - 4', 'Places - 2', 'People - 14') were mis-parsed as cards and removed.
Total 59 as published: the Interrupts header says 25 but 22 interrupts are listed.

Posted 'H-O-T-Jedi' dested Honor Of The Jedi; 'Insight' Your Insight Serves You Well; 'Tatooine' and 'Tatooine Cantina' the Light Premiere printings; 'Anikin's Podracer' Anakin's Podracer; 'I Did It' I Did It!.

Posted 'Yotts 'Pimp' Orren' dested Yotts Orren; 'Lando in Milennium Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon; 'Clash oh Sabers' Clash Of Sabers; 'Don't Get @#$%y' Don't Get Cocky; 'Run, Luke, Run' Run Luke, Run!; 'The Bith Shuffle & Desprate Reach' and 'Out of Commission & Transmission Termainated' the combo cards.
The strategy says he is thinking about playing the deck at the team tournament at Mirkwood (Minnesota); no result is given, so it stays a general deck.
